statement.zh: Brunton & Caton-Thompson 1928 正式报告巴达里文明及相关前王朝遗存，并含 Caton-Thompson 的赫马米耶聚落发掘。
statement.en: Brunton & Caton-Thompson 1928 formally publish the Badarian civilisation and related Predynastic remains, including Caton-Thompson’s Hemamieh settlement excavation.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only.
